description: low-pass FIR on real samples vs fir_filter_fff

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 1.8006525334202697e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 4.679766646165635 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 1.8006525334202697e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 1.0 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 5.179766646165635 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q17 (sum of |tap rounding error| 4.29903396636752e-5) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q17) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 1.1381387523200126 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 31-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 0.9121716286887076); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.1105 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.
